newsitem.title: GREECE: ATHLETICS-GERMANS DISCARD DISTANCE RUNNER FOR DOPING.
newsitem.headline: ATHLETICS-GERMANS DISCARD DISTANCE RUNNER FOR DOPING.

text.p: Distance runner Petra Wassiluk has been dropped from the German team for the world championships starting on Saturday after a positive dope test.

German athletic federation officials said on Wednesday that the 27-year-old 10,000 metres runner had been found to have excess levels of the stimulant caffeine in her body during a doping test in Spain last April.
Although Wassiluk's three-month suspension ends before the championships begin, she had been dropped from the German team because she produced her best qualifying times during the period of the ban.
